name: long-shadow
title: Long Shadow
description: A flat icon pops in and casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring. A built-in check badge stands in for the mark; a host replaces the contents of the .ls-mark layers with its own flat icon.
useWhen: A flat icon, badge or logo mark should get the classic flat-design long shadow, with a little motion in it.
A success, feature or app icon beat needs a calm, clean accent that fills the frame without extra elements.
You want depth on a flat mark without lighting it in 3D.
avoidWhen: The subject is a word that should rise out of the plane on a solid 3D body: use extrude-pop.
A line of text should be uncovered and wiped by moving shadows: use shadow-sweep-text.
The mark should land with a heavy impact rather than a soft pop: use impact-shake.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Start angle
variables.description: Shadow direction in degrees at the start (0 is right, 90 is down).

variables.label: End angle
variables.description: Shadow direction after the light swings.

variables.label: Fade
variables.description: Fade the shadow toward its far end, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Check
variables.description: Color of the check mark on the built-in badge.
